notes.title: FINALLY HERE!!
notes.content: The wait is over! Get your katanas and kunais ready and face the evil Shogun in our new adventure: Kyurinaga's Revenge! New levels, new characters, new villains and lots and lots of action! Here at Reco we cannot wait to see you guys playing our new game, all feedback is welcome!
